evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: 'Owned' vs 'rented' intelligence set as opposed ideas in a single balanced clause.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Perspective spoken of AS an asset — a thing possessed and retained — not mere vividness but a thing-as-another-thing mapping.
